On a clean-state run, 33/33 pass in ~20s (see /app/test_reports/pytest/results.xml). Coverage: historical write-guard (PATCH/DELETE → 405 + audit_log), force password change (428 on scope, weak/same rejection, full change → session revoked → new pw works → scope OK), forgot/reset (rate-limit 429, no user enumeration, mail sink writes token, roundtrip + reuse 400, weak 422, invalid token 400), evaluator historical scoped to person (Batool → 282), evaluator forbidden from admin historical, DQ summary (16 checks, 7 signals, sources_total=108, template_metadata_stale=2336), DQ drill + 404, V8 cohorts exact [(1,24,0,0),(2,30,1200,1382),(3,29,1160,1081),(4,35,1400,940)], cohort/3 detail (29 orgs with per-org counts), ORG-A01-01 journey (45 records / 40 legacy activities / 47 legacy arbitrations), unknown org 404, RBAC 401/403/428 on new endpoints from cross-role sessions, brute-force lockout regression, reconciliation counts regression (2565/57/17/45/1662/118/3760/3403/67/120/9). Frontend Playwright smoke passed for: consultant forced redirect to /change-password with forced-notice, /forgot-password generic-success, admin /admin/cohorts → click cohort-3 → /admin/cohorts/3 detail, /admin/organizations/ORG-A01-01/journey, /admin/data-quality signals table + drill modal open/close, mobile 390×780 reconciliation with no horizontal scroll + hamburger drawer, evaluator /evaluator/historical shows readonly-notice + 282 records + Batool's name when navigated on a settled session.

ui_bugs.issue: After inline forced change-password (fresh consultant/evaluator login → forced redirect → change → auto-navigate to role landing → drawer→historical), the initial fetch on the historical page occasionally returns 0 rows and the header shows 'المسندة إلى — في البيانات التاريخية (0 سجل)' (empty evaluator_name). A page reload OR navigating on a settled session (subsequent login) shows the correct 282 rows and Batool's name. Root cause is a race between cookie rotation from POST /auth/change-password and the SPA's next API call — the app fires historical fetch before the rotated cookie is applied to axios/fetch, or before /auth/me is refreshed with the new pw_version. Backend API itself is correct (verified via curl: change → historical returns total=282 with evaluator_name).

action_items: Investigate the post-forced-change race on /evaluator/historical: after POST /auth/change-password succeeds, either (a) await the rotated cookie/auth-context refresh before firing the first data fetch on the landed route, or (b) have the page retry once on empty result if it detects the session was just rotated. Simplest UX: after a successful forced change, do a hard-reload or replace(state) navigation to guarantee a clean fetch.
(Optional) Silence the initial 401 from /auth/me probe on Login (carry-over from iteration 1).
critical_code_review_comments: auth_routes.change_password rotates cookies via set_auth_cookies() in the same response — good. But the SPA doesn't necessarily re-issue /auth/me before its route-change fetch, so pages that fetch on mount right after redirect can race. Consider returning must_change=false and pw_version in the change-password response body so the client can update state synchronously.

immutable.py + explicit PATCH/DELETE endpoints on /api/admin/historical/arbitrations/{id} correctly return 405 with 'IMMUTABLE_HISTORICAL' and record 'historical_write_blocked' in audit_log — defense in depth works as designed.

check_reset_rate uses login_attempts collection with 'reset::{email}' identifier — reusing the same collection is fine but tests need to know the key naming to clear rate-limit state between runs. Consider a dedicated 'password_reset_rate' collection for clarity.

Historical / cohort / journey / DQ handlers do lots of count_documents calls in a loop (e.g. cohort_detail computes activity+arbitration counts per org synchronously in Python). For 29–35 orgs it's fine; if the org count grows, batch with aggregation $group.
dev_mail_sink.log has no rotation — will grow unbounded in the preview env.

rca of the issue: Frontend race after inline forced change-password. Reproduction: (1) log in as evaluator.test@edama.local via /login, (2) app auto-redirects to /change-password, (3) submit new+confirm valid password, (4) app auto-navigates to /evaluator (queue), (5) open drawer → التحكيمات التاريخية. Expected: 282 rows and 'بتول الرويلي'. Observed (intermittent, ~50% in this env): 0 rows, header shows em-dash for evaluator name. Root cause candidate: POST /auth/change-password returns Set-Cookie headers rotating access/refresh, but the SPA's next fetch (/api/evaluator/historical-arbitrations from the freshly navigated page) may go out before the browser has committed the new cookie to same-origin state OR the auth context/hook has re-fetched /auth/me with the new pw_version. A reload always fixes it (settled cookies + settled context). Mitigation options: (a) return updated user object + must_change in change-password response body and update client state atomically; (b) after successful forced change, force a window.location.assign() to the role landing (hard reload) so all subsequent fetches use settled cookies; (c) add a one-shot retry-on-empty for the historical page when the previous auth event was a change-password within the last second.
